description: Clean up and share your own saved voices (Seed Audio voices from a clip and trained voices), the same as the voice list in Audio Studio. action "delete" removes a voice for good (audio already made with it keeps its name); "turn_off" keeps it on the account but takes it out of every voice picker so it cannot speak; "turn_on" brings it back; "share" publishes it to the person's team so every teammate can see it and speak with it; "unshare" takes it back. Pass voice as the NAME you say (or its id); see your voices and which are on, off or shared with list_voices (mine_only true). Only the voice's owner can change it. Delete cannot be undone: say which voice will go and get a clear yes first. Free.

action.description: delete, turn_off, turn_on, share or unshare.

voice.description: The voice's name as the person says it, or its id.
